free=[j for j in range(48)if j not in p['results']['pivot_columns']];M=[[row[j]for j in free]for row in i['results']['kernel_vectors']]
def det(m):
 a=[list(map(Fraction,row))for row in m];out=Fraction(1);n=len(a)
 for k in range(n):
  j=next(j for j in range(k,n)if a[j][k])
  if j!=k:a[j],a[k]=a[k],a[j];out=-out
  pivot=a[k][k];out*=pivot
  for j in range(k+1,n):
   scale=a[j][k]/pivot
   for t in range(k,n):a[j][t]-=scale*a[k][t]
 return out
